measureRecords.whatItDoes: Require 300 registered voters’ signatures for a voter-proposed Financial Town Referendum ballot question.

Make the budget receiving the most votes at the Financial Town Referendum take effect. The Committee on Appropriations budget would take effect unless an alternative budget is proposed and receives more votes than that committee budget.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve those rules for selecting the budget that takes effect.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed clarification of budget voting rules.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow each registered voter to submit no more than one ballot question to the Financial Town Referendum.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve limiting each registered voter to one submitted question.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed limit on submitted questions.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Limit voter-proposed Financial Town Referendum questions to the total municipal budget, total school budget, or both. Those questions could not propose changes to individual budget line items.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the budget-total limit and exclusion of individual line-item changes.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed restriction on voter-proposed questions.
